title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Dashboard relationships from imported BI files**: When you import a Power BI or Tableau file with Genie Code, migration tooling now creates dashboard relationships where it detects them in the source file. See [Import BI files using Genie Code](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi).
* **Customize date picker quick-select options with Genie Code**: You can now ask Genie Code for dashboard authoring to customize the quick-select options in a date range picker filter, such as keeping only day-based ranges. For an example prompt, see [Optional: Customize the date picker quick-select options with Genie Code](/aws/en/dashboards/tutorials/create-dashboard#customize-date-picker).
* **Full undo and redo in Genie Code**: Genie Code for dashboard authoring now supports full undo and redo. Each Genie Code response is a single step that you can undo as a unit, including restoring an emptied dashboard. See [Use Genie Code for dashboard authoring](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/dashboard-agent).
* **Semantic validation for AI-authored metrics**: Genie Code for dashboard authoring now automatically runs a semantic validation check after it creates a widget. The check validates business definitions, grain, attribution, population, time window, units, scale, and category values to improve the accuracy and consistency of metrics.
* **Low-code filters on measures**: Local metric views now provide a low-code option for adding filters to measures. See [Step 3: Define a filter](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/create#define-filters).
* **Improved low-code UI for imported metric views**: Metric views imported from Unity Catalog now use an improved low-code UI for extensions and modifications. See [Extend a Unity Catalog metric view](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/local-metric-views#extend-a-uc-metric-view).
* **Metric view display names on dashboard widgets**: Dashboard widgets now show the display name defined for each field in a local metric view instead of the literal field name. See [Local metric views](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/local-metric-views).
* **Cross-filtering includes the facet field**: Cross-filtering on a faceted chart now includes the facet field as part of the filter. See [Apply cross-filtering](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters#cross-filter).
* **Applied filters in email attachments**: Dashboard authors can now include the applied filters as a separate tabular attachment in email subscriptions. See [Email attachments](/aws/en/dashboards/share/schedule-subscribe#email-attachments).
* **Warehouse picker for full-page Genie Code**: The warehouse picker now appears for full-page Genie Code. See [Full page Genie Code](/aws/en/genie-code/full-page).
* **Dark mode scrollbar fix**: Fixed a bug where the filter drop-down scrollbar did not appear in dark mode.
* **Line chart tooltip fix**: Fixed a bug where tooltips did not appear on line charts.
